summary: A dark INK section placed between Pricing and the Closing CTA, extending the homepage's existing vocabulary verbatim — amber eyebrow, two-tone headline, pricing-grid card pair — with macOS as a lit, hoverable primary card and Windows as a recessed, deliberately motionless 'Coming soon' card that renders no button at all rather than a fake disabled one. Derived faithfully from the live homepage as sole style authority, corroborated by two curated widgets-dashboard-ui pieces (paired dark cards with top-right brand badges; warm-dusk glassmorphic cards over amber glow).
